svg.title: Proposed colour roles for the terminal client
svg.desc: The overview and the plan view of pm-operator, each on a dark and a light terminal background, using five colour roles: attention yellow, running cyan, done green, danger red, muted dim, plus bold for the place and reverse for the selection.
